outcome: postoperative recurrence of abdominal wall endometriosis
cohort: The study included 398 patients with biopsy-confirmed abdominal wall endometriosis who underwent surgical treatment and were followed up for recurrence.
finding: The number of cesarean sections, duration of operation, and amount of intraoperative bleeding were positively correlated with the recurrence of abdominal wall endometriosis.
mod_finding: A higher number of cesarean sections was positively correlated with the recurrence of abdominal wall endometriosis.
followup_time: Up to 65 months (median time to relapse was 16 months)
